brief:
Arab Palestinian Investment Company (APIC) delivered robust financial results for the first nine months of 2026, the Palestine News Network reported. Revenues reached USD 1.069 billion while earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization (EBITDA) rose 54 percent to USD 78.8 million.

Profits attributable to shareholders surged 417.4 percent to USD 20.5 million over the same period, marking significant gains across the company's key financial metrics.

title: Arab Palestinian Investment Company reports 54% EBITDA growth in first nine months
